<OPTIONS>
/NODE=KM.[A15_PROD_21.].MARS
/UN=//
/PW=
/OLEDB=SQLPlus
/ENGINE=VA
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=
/CSV=yeuchuan_a0_10607.tab
/HEADERS=prodgroup3,Link,lot,out_date,wtb
/INSTANCE=10607
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 2.1-a0. Fetching MARS Data
/RECORD=WIP_Lot_History_v2@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT 
          prodgroup3 AS prodgroup3
         ,Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Link,',',';'),chr(9),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),chr(34),''''),chr(7),' ') AS Link
         ,lot AS lot
         ,To_Char(out_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS out_date
         ,Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(wtb,',',';'),chr(9),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),chr(34),''''),chr(7),' ') AS wtb
FROM
(
SELECT  
          p.prodgroup3 AS prodgroup3
         ,(SELECT la.attribute_value FROM @[]@F_LotAttribute la where la.lot= f9.lot AND la.attribute_number = 6244 AND la.src_erase_date IS NULL AND rownum <= 1) AS Link
         ,f0.lot AS lot
         ,f0.out_date AS out_date
         ,(SELECT la.attribute_value FROM @[]@F_LotAttribute la where la.lot= f9.lot AND la.attribute_number = 1225 AND la.src_erase_date IS NULL AND rownum <= 1) AS wtb
FROM 
@[]@F_LotHist f0
LEFT JOIN @[]@F_Product p ON p.product = f0.product AND p.facility = f0.facility AND NVL(p.latest_version,'Y') = 'Y' -- AND p.product_version = f0.product_version
INNER JOIN @[]@F_Lot f9 ON f9.lot = f0.lot
WHERE
NVL(f0.history_deleted_flag,'N') = 'N'
AND      f0.owner <> 'EMPTYFOUP'
 AND      f0.operation In ('1204'
,'2511') 
 AND      f0.out_date >= (SYSDATE - 12/24) 
-- Tail A
)
WHERE
              wtb = 'N' 
/*END SQL*/


<---- New Query ---->

<OPTIONS>
/NODE=KM.ARIES
/UN=//
/PW=
/OLEDB=SQLPlus
/ENGINE=VA
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=
/CSV=yeuchuan_a1_10607.tab
/HEADERS=Bonder,lot_1,test_name,max_time,min_time
/INSTANCE=10607
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 2.1-a1. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT  DISTINCT 
          Bonder AS Bonder
         ,lot_1 AS lot_1
         ,test_name AS test_name
         ,Max(max_time) AS max_time
         ,Min(min_time) AS min_time
FROM
(
SELECT  
          dt.test_head_id AS Bonder
         ,ats.lot AS lot_1
         ,t.test_name AS test_name
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS max_time
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS min_time
FROM 
A_Testing_Session ats
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ats.ts_id
AND dt.lao_start_ww = ctr.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ctr.ts_id AND dt.dt_id = ctr.dt_id
WHERE ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
 AND      (ats.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a0_10607.tab", lot, "ats.lot In") 
 AND      ats.operation = '1204' 
 AND      t.test_name = 'PROCESSTIMESTAMP' 
)
GROUP BY 
          Bonder
         ,lot_1
         ,test_name
/*END SQL*/


<---- New Query ---->

<OPTIONS>
/RESET=Y
/NODE=.\
/OLEDB=SQLite
/ENGINE=SQLite
/UN=
/PW=
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=Yes
/CSV=timestamp_raw.csv
/TABLE=yeuchuan_a0_10607.tab,yeuchuan_a1_10607.tab
/HEADERS=prodgroup3,Link,Bonder,lot,out_date,test_name,max_time,min_time
/DELETE=*Instance*
/INSTANCE=10607
/SQLITE_DT=,prodgroup3(c),Link(x),Bonder(c),lot(c),out_date(d),lot_1(c),test_name(c),max_time(c),min_time(c),wtb(x)
/QUOTECSV=Y
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>


DROP INDEX IF EXISTS IdxA1;
Create Index IF NOT EXISTS IdxA1 ON [yeuchuan_a1_10607] ([lot_1]);

SELECT /*L0*/ 
          a0.[prodgroup3] AS [prodgroup3]
         ,Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(Replace(a0.[Link],',',';'),CAST(X'09' AS TEXT),' '),CAST(X'0A' AS TEXT),' '),CAST(X'0D' AS TEXT),' '),CAST(X'22' AS TEXT),''''),CAST(X'07' AS TEXT),' ') AS [Link]
         ,a1.[Bonder] AS [Bonder]
         ,a0.[lot] AS [lot]
         ,a0.[out_date] AS [out_date]
         ,a1.[test_name] AS [test_name]
         ,a1.[max_time] AS [max_time]
         ,a1.[min_time] AS [min_time]
FROM 
           [yeuchuan_a0_10607] a0
 LEFT OUTER JOIN [yeuchuan_a1_10607] a1
  ON a0.[lot] = a1.[lot_1]

<---- New Query ---->

<OPTIONS>
/JSL=Y
/OUTLOOK=N
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 3. Create a JMP Program
/INSTANCE=10607
</OPTIONS>
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Load file to a JMP Table table
|
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
If (IsEmpty(::Default_Dir),::Default_Dir ="$default$dir$");
::MyInFile1= ::Default_Dir || "timestamp_raw.csv";
Try(Close( Data Table ("timestamp_raw_csv") , NoSave);,Print("Warning Only: Table could not be found!"));

::myspfcsv= Open(::MyInFile1,
Import Settings(
   End Of Line( CRLF, CR, LF ),
   End Of Field( Comma ),
   Strip Quotes( 1 ),
   Use Apostrophe as Quotation Mark( 0 ),
   Labels( 1 ),
   Column Names Start( 1 ),
   Data Starts( 2 ),
   Lines To Read( All ),
   Year Rule( "10-90" )
   ));
Wait(0.1);
/*Set Columns Lowercase*/
For(j = 1, j <= NCol(myspfcsv), j++,
  col = Column(j); nm = lowercase(char(column name(j)));
  col << Set Name(nm);
);
::myspfcsv << Set Name("timestamp_raw_csv");

dt=current data table ();
dt<<select where (is missing (:Bonder));
dt<<delete rows;
dt<<new column ("TimeDelta_max", numeric,format (fixed dec, 8,3), formula((:out_date - :max_time) / 3600));
dt<<new column ("TimeDelta_min", numeric,format (fixed dec, 8,3), formula((:out_date - :min_time) / 3600));

dt<<select where ((:TimeDelta_max>0)&(:TimeDelta_min<24));
dt<<delete rows;
strpath="\\kmatshfs.intel.com\kmatanalysis$\MAOATM\KuAT\TCB\";
dt << save  (strpath||"TimeDelta.csv");
